title: Normalized native restriction and sheaf tensor
statement: Let k₀ be a finite field and let ℓ be a prime different from its characteristic. Let j:U→Z be an open immersion of k₀-schemes. Use the actual native Weil sheaves and pullback of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework] and the actual native sheaf tensor of [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations]. For each pair M,N there is an isomorphism j*(M⊗N) ≅ j*M⊗j*N whose underlying forward map is exactly the existing ordinary balanced comparison adicUpperStarTensorLeftIso evaluated at N.carrier and M.carrier. This is an assertion only about sheaves and includes no complex or K-flatness conclusion.

proof.text: Use the actual ordinary balanced coefficient pullback tensor comparison. On a pure tensor, composing restriction and Frobenius in either order pulls back the same two sections and applies their Weil structure maps, since j is over k₀. Balancing and sheafification descend this equality.

lean.statement:
theorem native_open_restriction_tensor :
    ∃ rho : ∀ M N : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z,
      (upperStar k₀ l j).obj (tensor k₀ l Z N M) ≅
        tensor k₀ l U ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj N) ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj M),
      ∀ M N, HEq ((rho M N).hom.hom.f)
        ((ProEtale.adicUpperStarTensorLeftIso l
          (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _)) N.carrier).hom.app M.carrier)
